## API

`run_profile_statistics(*, population, window_population, contract, outputs, load_reference, selected_partition_keys=None, accepted_partitions=None)` in `auction_flow_profile_statistics.py` is the public reducer. Root passes the already-authenticated obs39 and window46 payloads; this helper does not reload those JSON objects.

`profile_partition_plan(population, contract)` returns the same collection/root/economic-year keys as window statistics, plus canonical encodable keys. Neighbor/past units in the same collection may be read for 240-minute lookback and 60-minute future mass; they are not selected keys. Weekly and monthly collections stay separate.

Public `run` always checks frozen kind, version, all 14 geometry variants, all 6 bar proxies, eight clocks, rolling 5/15/60/240, latencies, stage policy, and date-block settings. A fixture token cannot skip that. Fixtures may inject `cash_session_table` and local `source_collections`; production calendar must match the frozen cash RTH identity.

## Reconstruction

Cells come from each unit’s accepted measurement receipt via `read_json_artifact` (`trade.sparse_profile` ordered `[row, buy, sell, unknown]` plus unpriced). Observation Parquet is exhausted with `read_series_tables` for clocks, coverage, moments, and row counts. Per-atom side/total identity must match; mismatches fail.

`IntegerMass` keeps integer histograms with add/remove for rolling 5/15/60/240 and developing prefixes. Completed-anchor variant scans run once per anchor. Fraction kernels (`view_sparse` / `transform_mass` / `geometry` / `bar_allocation_rows` / `AnchorTPO` / footprint) stay the reference; production converts only at emit time.

Completed named clocks emit all 14 variants and all 6 bar proxies (flat-bar lost mass retained). Developing RTH / 18-17 and rolling emit one-tick 70% baseline plus M05 side, M07 VWAP/quantiles/bands/pin069, M13 footprint, and TPO 15/30/60 visit vs range-proxy with IB 30/60. Final single prints require a complete anchor and two complete brackets. Zero priced mass is null geometry; missing atoms stay missing.

Overlapping identities collapse only on exact alias; conflicts are retained. Delayed selection publishes at `max(input known, selection, cut+latency)`, never at a retrospective origin. UTC day storage does not mark a calendar year unavailable.

## Joins and statistics

Window46 features/labels are indexed by exact path/root/instrument/contract/cut. All three latencies and 5/15/60/remaining-RTH horizons join only when formation complete, coverage known, and feature/label stage agree. Label high/low/last yield POC/VA touch, traverse, and terminal inside/outside; first-touch order stays unidentified. Future mass uses the cut-frozen grid plus overflow. Frozen vs developing VA splits boundary motion from price crossing.

Groups are collection/root/year/stage/session/anchor/variant. Equal-date means use one shared 1000×5 moving-block weight matrix (seed 20260908). Raw quantiles 0.01–0.99 keep metric missingness. Event counts are not replaced by date cells. Alias support is by canonical raw-stream hash. Prespecified undefined/failed/no-event/censor cohorts stay in the tables.

## Artifacts and resources

Each partition writes typed Arrow series: unit cells, geometry, TPO, forward joins, plus completeness JSON. The reducer writes groups, paired contrasts, summary, and a markdown report of every group (not a first-20 slice). Partition identity binds scientific contract fields, source refs, and window refs — not output paths. Reuse authenticates every consumer file hash before accept.

The helper never spawns processes. CPU and output bytes are measured from reads and serialization. `project_profile_resources` scales measured source-byte, atom, and geometry-row work by 1.5 for the weekly NQ 2021 pilot.

Independent fixtures in `tests/test_auction_flow_profile_reference.py` go through actual `run`/tables: 68 vs 70 plateau/ties, side-conserving coarse/triangular, all six bar proxies including flat, null zero/unpriced, TPO visit vs range and final singles, DST/early-close/midnight, distinct contracts and aliases, censor/no-event, ns > 2^53, weekly vs monthly isolation, future overflow, 2×2×2 baseline identities, 1-vs-100-cut date weights, hash tampering, and Parquet NULL/int64 roundtrip. Those checks remain unexecuted.
